fixed_endpoint.cover_text: This class includes 10 hours of instruction: three weeknight classes can be taken as an accelerated 16 hour cluster or as standalone classes over several weeks. In classes one and two, students learn modal synthesis, the concepts by which musical intervals are produced during modulation as a result of the travel of sound waves through an acoustically heterogeneous medium (such as air, water or other conductive media). Specifically, in both classes, students learn about the modulations of sound propagation as it transfers through the medium. In class three, students are introduced to the framework of an ensemble, elaborating on steps within the musicians' mind (deCONSTRUCTION)

unverified.cover_text:
This class includes 10 hours of instruction: three weeknight hours in a classroom setting that includes no expectation of a minimum classroom attendance for the period. Participants may ask questions with the instructor.
Bipolar: Learn about the differential diagnosis and management of bipolar substance use disorders, as well as the strategies and treatment of other emotional disorders, such as anxiety and depression.
Abused: Learn to assess the individual risks of alcohol and illicit drug use, and how to support your friend, family member, or loved one in the face of those risks. We also talk about what to do with substance abuse denial and the metastatic principles of antidoxamines.
